properties.why: Pierce School Playground, north edge of the lawn by the path (audit cell c_-41_-22, proposed by the crown finder, in neither the Town of Brookline inventory nor OpenStreetMap). A dense dark crown 6 m across with its own shadow in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023, and bare spreading branches at the same place in the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs of spring 2023 and spring 2025 (credit MassGIS). Species not clear, so none is set; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown.

Pierce School Playground, between the lawn and the school's long west wall (audit cell c_-41_-22, in neither the Town of Brookline inventory nor OpenStreetMap). A compact dark crown about 9 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023; the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photograph of spring 2025 (credit MassGIS) shows a dense brown mass of bare branches over the same ground. Species not clear, so none is set; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown.

Longwood Playground, beside the car park on its north-east side (audit cell c_-37_-18, in neither the Town of Brookline inventory nor OpenStreetMap). A round dark crown 5.8 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023, and a bare tree with a trunk shadow and radiating branches at the same place in the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photograph of spring 2023 (credit MassGIS). Species not clear, so none is set; height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown.

Longwood Playground, at the path corner just south-east of the previous tree (audit cell c_-37_-18, in neither the Town of Brookline inventory nor OpenStreetMap). A compact dark crown 5.4 m across in the USGS NAIP photograph of 7 July 2023 that is still dark green in the MassGIS 15 cm leaf-off photographs of spring 2023 and spring 2025 (credit MassGIS), so an evergreen; the species is not clear. Height is left to the pipeline's estimate from the crown.
